method: the text layer of the PDFs (pypdf), not OCR. Printed lines that wrap are joined into one logical line; runs of spaces are collapsed; two text-layer artefacts are corrected to match the printed page, which was checked line by line against a 300 dpi render (pdftoppm) on 2026-11-12: a missing space between a bold label and its value ("CON124.4" is printed "CON 124.4", "DEL128.05" is "DEL 128.05") and the radar symbol printed in the left margin before "NORCAL" ("®NORCAL" -> "® NORCAL"). The right-hand column (charts) is kept apart in 'chart_refs'. Characters are those of the text layer: º (U+00BA) for degrees, ´ (U+00B4) for feet/minutes, – en dash, — em dash, ‡, ®.

lines: HAYWARD EXEC (HWD)(KHWD) 2 W UTC–8(–7DT) N37º39.54´ W122º07.30´
52 B TPA—See Remarks NOTAM FILE HWD
RWY 10R–28L: H5694X150 (ASPH–GRVD) S–30, D–75, 2S–95 MIRL 0.4% up E
RWY 10R: REIL. VASI(V4R)—GA 3.0º TCH 25´. Thld dsplcd 826´. Tree. Rgt tfc.
RWY 28L: REIL. VASI(V4L)—GA 4.0º TCH 35´. Thld dsplcd 676´.
RWY 10L–28R: H3108X75 (ASPH) S–13 MIRL 0.3% up SE

SERVICE: S4 FUEL 100LL, JET A, UL94 OX 1, 3 LGT When twr clsd MIRL Rwy 10R–28L preset low ints, to increase ints ACTIVATE—CTAF. When twr clsd VASI Rwy 10R and Rwy 28L opr SS–SR, PAPI Rwy 10L, PAPI Rwy 28R, REIL Rwy 10R and Rwy 28L unavailable.
NOISE: Noise abatement procedures in effect ctc arpt for noise rules 510–293–8669.

AIRPORT REMARKS: Attended 1600–0100Z‡. When tower clsd Rwy 10L–28R CLOSED. UL94 fuel avbl at self–serve island. Flocks of birds feeding along the shoreline, creek areas and at the golf course to the north, on occasion may fly across various parts of the arpt. SAID in use. Operate transponders with altitude reporting mode and ADS–B (if equipped) enabled on all airport surfaces. 155´ energy complex exhaust stack 1.5 NM southwest of arpt. Do not overfly energy complex facility below 1,000´ MSL. TPA—652(600) Rwy 10R–28L, 852(800) Rwy 10L–28R. Rwy 10R has ldg distance remaining signs (lgtd) north side of rwy. Rwy 28L has ldg distance remaining signs (lgtd) south side of rwy. Twy A not visible from twr between Twy B and Twy C. Twy A1 clsd to acft with wingspan greater than 100´. Twy Z1 clsd to acft with wingspan greater than 94´. Transient helicopter tfc use helipads west of green ramp located at base of twr.
CLEARANCE DELIVERY PHONE: For CD when ATCT is clsd ctc NorCal Apch at 916-361-0516.
AIRSPACE: CLASS D svc 1500–0500Z‡; other times CLASS E.
RADIO AIDS TO NAVIGATION: NOTAM FILE OAK.
OAKLAND (VH) (DH) VORW/DME 116.8 OAK Chan 115 N37º43.56´ W122º13.42´ 113º 6.3 NM to fld. 13/17E.
LOC/DME 111.5 I–HWD Chan 52 Rwy 28L. Localizer offset angle 3.00 deg. LOC unmonitored when ATCT clsd.

HWD.HS 1: Acft approaching Twy A from the ramp sometimes fail to turn onto Twy A, proceeding onto Twy E and ultimately Rwy 10L–28R. Acft exiting Rwy 10L–28R sometimes fail to ctc GND prior to taxiing to parking.
HWD.HS 3: Area not visible from ATCT. Acft exiting Rwy 10L–28R sometimes fail to ctc GND prior to taxiing to parking.
HWD.HS 5: Rwy 28L hold bars on Twy A1 and Twy Z1 are at non–typical lctn. Pilots sometime pass the hold bar wo authorization.

rows.plan_value: FAA ATCT, call HAYWARD, hours 0700-2100 local; tower closed: 10L/28R closed, CTAF 120.2, MIRL 10R/28L preset low
rows.note: 1500-0500Z = 0700-2100 PST (UTC-8); with ‡ (legend: one hour earlier during DST) 1400-0400Z = 0700-2100 PDT. So 0700-2100 local all year. Also confirmed: "When tower clsd Rwy 10L–28R CLOSED", "CTAF 120.2", "When twr clsd MIRL Rwy 10R–28L preset low ints, to increase ints ACTIVATE—CTAF". The PLAN omits that, with the tower closed, VASI 10R/28L run sunset to sunrise and PAPI 10L, PAPI 28R and REIL 10R/28L are unavailable, and the LOC is unmonitored. Operator (FAA) and call sign are not stated in the CS.
